notes:
Lead: Maya Chen. Mid-market product analytics SaaS building in-app search + recommendations.

Context:

POC plan + notes from calls:

- Request: sample SOW + pricing matrix for reserved nodes (3 sizes) + overage policy. Shared pricing deck (drive:/decks/terraceforge_pricing_v2.pdf).

Customer quotes / anecdotes:
- "We need predictable monthly spend — our CFO won't approve unknown egress spikes."
- "If we can cut reindex time by >50% and keep query latency stable, this pays for itself quickly."

Next tactical steps (short):

- Run Hosted API small-sample embedding test (1-2 days) — Redwood to provision API keys and sample rate limits.
- Schedule dedicated throughput window mid-December for bulk ingest test (SE + infra on-call).

Internal notes for Redwood team:

- Observe their batch job pattern: incremental nightly deltas + full reindex quarterly; recommend prefix caching + intelligent batching to reduce cost.
